activity_summary: The latch sprang when you lifted it softly. You sneezed twice on the walk home, and you are not ill. You think she heard the latch. You did not go down, and you did not make a patient of yourself.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Not spoken to. He thinks she heard the latch. She does not come up.

entities.name: the Jackdaw
entities.context: Mentioned in The latch, and twice

facets.activity: Came in softly and stayed up

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The latch sprang. I had it as soft as I could, and it sprang.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Twice, on the walk from Shoreditch. The air. I am not ill.
